title: Los Angeles Started Right Here in 1781
description:
Step into 245 years of Los Angeles history—without spending a dime!

On September 4, Los Angeles commemorates the founding of the pueblo in 1781. From its Indigenous roots and early settlers to the many communities that continue to shape it, Los Angeles has a rich and complex history.

Explore that history with a FREE walking tour led by the docents of Las Angelitas del Pueblo. Tours of El Pueblo Historical Monument feature Olvera Street, Pico House, Avila Adobe, and other significant landmarks.
📅 Thursday through Saturday
🕙 Tours begin at 10 a.m., 11 a.m., and noon
💲 Free

Discover the people, places, and cultures that have contributed to the story of Los Angeles.
